Yes. You can currently use an Expression visual shader node to access the missing builtins.

However, this is not discoverable, and requires an awkward workaround if you want to set an output builtin like `POSITION`. Since Expression nodes aren't compiled unless connected to an output, you need to connect to one of the supported output builtin slots in the Output node, and add"passthrough" inputs and outputs to the Expression node, like this example for `POSITION`:
